title: Aromatic Brazilian Rose Cake
description: Floral, velvety cake leavened with instant yeast and steamed in a bamboo basket, sugar‑free friendly and perfect for a solo dinner dessert.
instructions: In a mixing bowl whisk together flour, instant yeast, powdered erythritol, ground cinnamon and salt.
Warm milk and almond milk to 40°C and stir in rosewater and vanilla extract.
Pour the liquid mixture into the dry ingredients and beat until a smooth batter forms.
Add melted butter and coconut oil, then fold in the egg until fully incorporated.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and let the batter rise for 45 minutes at room temperature.
Grease a bamboo steamer basket with coconut oil and line it with parchment paper.
Spoon the risen batter into the steamer, filling each cup about three-quarters full.
Steam the cake over boiling water for 20 minutes, keeping the lid on.
Remove the steamed cake and allow it to cool for 10 minutes before slicing.
Serve warm with a dusting of powdered erythritol or a drizzle of rosewater glaze.
